namliyaBrowse.title: Namliya
namliyaBrowse.description: What overflows at one organization fills the need of another — browse and request, and the agreement is completed in the conversation.

namliyaService.paymentNote: Transferred after delivery confirmation — not before.

namliyaResource.taxNote: + 14% VAT on the swap value (Shahmahm only)
namliyaResource.paymentNote: + 10 Shahmahm for moderation · + EGP 1,000 refundable cash deposit — the deposit is not subject to tax
namliyaResource.securityDepositNote: The deposit is paid in cash at handover and refunded in full after the joint inspection. If there’s any damage, the repair cost is deducted from it by mutual agreement. And if you disagree, mediation comes first.

postServiceNamliya.addPostDesc: Write the service in the language of the organization requesting it — what exactly do you offer, and what does the other party receive at the end?
postServiceNamliya.offerTypePlaceholder: Clear single sentence — e.g. Video recording and documentation of events
postServiceNamliya.descriptionPlaceholder: What do you offer? What does the other party receive, and are there any special conditions?
postServiceNamliya.descNotice: The first two lines appear on the listing card when people browse, so make sure they explain the service by themselves.
postServiceNamliya.categoryNotice: One word describing the service type — appears as a tag on the card.
postServiceNamliya.priceNote: The value is deducted from your organization's monthly limit upon approval.
priceData: Human Services = service hours × hourly rate (1–5 Shahama)
For public services (workshops, courses, events) = (total hours × rate) ÷ seats.
The hourly rate is set by the service provider between 1 and 5 — these limits protect the network from extremes on either side.
You can post for free — it’s registered with a value of zero and doesn’t count against your limit.

validation.titleMin: Title must be at least 5 characters
validation.pricePositive: Price must be a positive number

postServiceNamliya.cardInfo: You're an admin — posting happens immediately.
postServiceNamliya.cardDesc: If a team member fills out this form, it's saved as a 'draft' and awaits your approval before appearing on Namliya.

postResourceNamliya.desc: On Namliya · your organization's equipment and spaces
postResourceNamliya.imagesDesc: Photos make a huge difference in resources — the borrowing organization wants to see the actual condition before requesting.
postResourceNamliya.addPhotos: Drag photos here or click to upload
postResourceNamliya.photoDesc: Up to 6 photos · JPG or PNG · Max 5MB per photo
postResourceNamliya.offerTypePlaceholder: Example: Cinema camera with two lenses
postResourceNamliya.descriptionPlaceholder: Condition, specifications, included items, and pickup/return location.
postResourceNamliya.categoryHint: One word describing the service type — appears as a tag on the card.
postResourceNamliya.vatHint: + 14% VAT on barter value — Cash deposit is not subject to tax.
pricingGuide: Human service = Service hours × hourly rate (1 to 5 Shahama).
Organization public services (workshops, courses, programs) = (Presenter hours × hourly rate) ÷ number of seats.
The hourly rate is set by the service provider between 1 and 5 — these limits protect the network from over/under valuing.
You can publish for free — it is recorded with zero value and not deducted from your quota.
postResourceNamliya.guaranteesDesc: Both are optional — and appear to the other party on the resource page and in the agreement.
postResourceNamliya.cashDepositDesc: An amount paid in cash upon receipt and fully refunded after mutual inspection.
postResourceNamliya.supervisedUseDesc: A member of your team delivers, receives, and inspects the resource — for a separate value.
postResourceNamliya.summaryTitle: Cost summary for the other party
postResourceNamliya.summaryNote: Deposit is in cash and separate from Shahama — fully refunded after inspection if there is no damage.
postResourceNamliya.adminOnlyTitle: Resource publishing is for admins only.
postResourceNamliya.adminOnlyDesc: Team members can publish human services as drafts, but physical resources are published by the organization manager directly.

namliyaDrafts.title: Namliya — Market for organizations
namliyaDrafts.description: The drafts · services submitted by the team and waiting for your approval before appearing
namliyaDrafts.note: Approval is for managers only. Team members can edit their drafts until they're approved or rejected, and after publishing, edits come back to you.
